_A_DATE_INPUT_KEYBOARD_HINT_: Arrow keys move by day and week, Page Up and Page Down by month, with Shift by year, Home and End to the start and end of the week. Enter selects the date, Escape closes the calendar.
_A_DATE_INPUT_ERROR_DATE_: Enter a valid date, e.g. {{ example }}
_A_DATE_INPUT_ERROR_MIN_: The date must not be before {{ date }}
_A_DATE_INPUT_ERROR_MAX_: The date must not be after {{ date }}
_A_DATE_INPUT_ERROR_RANGE_: The end must not be before the start
_A_DATE_INPUT_ERROR_MONTH_: Enter a valid month, e.g. {{ example }}
_A_DATE_INPUT_ERROR_YEAR_: Enter a valid year, e.g. {{ example }}
_A_DATE_INPUT_ERROR_STEP_: Only every {{ step }} minutes, e.g. {{ example }}
_A_DATE_INPUT_ERROR_MIN_TIME_: The time must not be before {{ time }}
_A_DATE_INPUT_ERROR_MAX_TIME_: The time must not be after {{ time }}
_A_DATE_INPUT_ERROR_MIN_DAYS_: The period must be at least {{ days }} days
_A_DATE_INPUT_ERROR_MAX_DAYS_: The period must be at most {{ days }} days
_A_DATE_INPUT_ERROR_WEEK_: Enter a valid week, e.g. {{ example }}
_A_DATE_INPUT_RANGE_START_ANNOUNCE_: Start: {{ date }}. Choose the end date.
_A_DATE_INPUT_ERROR_QUARTER_: Enter a valid quarter, e.g. {{ example }}
